name: Stormbrand
desc: Rune of the Edge with charged slime gel inlay and a raw sapphire, on a Fine or better slab. Adds in a weapon: +8% of damage dealt as lightning and +20% Crit Damage.

name: Hearthward
desc: Rune of Warding with warm slime gel inlay, on any slab grade. Adds in armor: +8% Heat Resistance.

name: Winter's Edge
desc: Rune of the Edge with chilled slime gel inlay and a cut garnet, on a Superb or better slab. Adds in a weapon: +6 cold damage per hit and +3% Crit.

name: Twiceforged Seal
desc: Rune of Might and Rune of Warding cut on one slab with gold leaf inlay, Fine or better. Adds +6% Damage in a weapon or +5 Armor in armor.
